key_insight: EBP replaces static offline behavior priors with a Q-guided generative prior learned from the online replay buffer to improve exploration, stability, and sample efficiency.
engineering_relevance: This is relevant for autonomous robotics and industrial control because it can reduce reliance on expert demonstrations while improving online RL performance in real systems.
method: Train a Q-guided conditional VAE (Q-CVAE) on online replay data to generate high-value expert-like action priors.
Use Expert Policy Guidance (EPG) to select actions from the generative support set for policy exploitation.
Apply Policy Gradient Correction (PGC) to align Q-guidance with expert supervision and stabilize updates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive evaluation on Gym, PyBullet, and DMControl benchmarks, where EBP outperforms state-of-the-art online RL methods with higher sample efficiency and more stable convergence.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and coverage of the online replay buffer, and the added generative and correction modules could increase training complexity.
